note: 2026-09-26 Unit 4 rebuild: Learn holds only There is and There are; every sentence is practice on known rooms, objects and the Unit 2 counting photos (seven chairs, eight books, nine cars). A wrong option changes only the number or is/are; counting photos stay out of four-picture cards.

lesson.title: 4.4 There Is and There Are
lesson.unit_outcome: Say where people and things are at home, describe a short daily routine, ask and answer Do you...? questions, and say the day and the time.
lesson.goal: Use there is for one thing and there are for two or more, in rooms and with the Unit 2 counting photos.
lesson.grammar_function: There is + a + singular noun; there are + number + plural noun; a location phrase from 4.3.
lesson.prerequisite: 4.1-4.3 rooms, home objects and place words; 2.6-2.7 numbers and plurals.
lesson.speaking_outcome: Say what there is in a room and how many things there are.

items.text: There is a bed in the bedroom.
items.es: Hay una cama en el dormitorio.
prefer: There are two beds in the bedroom.

items.text: There is a lamp next to the sofa.
items.es: Hay una lámpara al lado del sofá.
prefer: There are two lamps next to the sofa.

items.text: There is a computer in the living room.
items.es: Hay una computadora en la sala.
prefer: There are two computers in the living room.

items.text: There are two chairs in the dining room.
items.es: Hay dos sillas en el comedor.
prefer: There is a chair in the dining room.

items.text: There are three books on the table.
items.es: Hay tres libros sobre la mesa.
prefer: There are two books on the table.

items.text: There are two bags under the table.
items.es: Hay dos bolsas debajo de la mesa.
prefer: There is a bag under the table.
